results.question: Do creatures phasing back in trigger enter the battlefield abilities?
results.text: No, creatures phasing back in do not trigger enter-the-battlefield abilities. Phasing does not cause a permanent to change zones; it only changes the permanent’s status from “phased out” to “phased in” (rule [702.26c]). Because the permanent never leaves or enters the battlefield, zone-change triggers—including enters-the-battlefield triggers—do not trigger when a permanent phases in or out (rule [702.26d]). This is explicitly stated: “Zone-change triggers don’t trigger when a permanent phases in or out” (rule [702.26d]). Additionally, rule [603.6a] defines enters-the-battlefield triggers as zone-change triggers that fire when a permanent enters the battlefield, but phasing does not involve entering the battlefield. Therefore, no enter-the-battlefield ability triggers upon phasing in.
